modelConfig.unsupported: Not available (instance unreachable or predates this feature)

fields.max_batch_size: Maximum requests merged into one batch
fields.batch_timeout: Max seconds to wait for a full batch before dispatching a partial one
fields.continuous_batching: Refill the batch as soon as a slot frees instead of waiting for the whole batch
fields.adaptive_batching: Shrink the batch timeout dynamically under low load
fields.min_batch_timeout: Lower bound of the adaptive batch timeout
fields.adaptive_queue_threshold: Queue depth above which adaptive batching engages
fields.accelerator: Compute backend (cpu / cuda / metal …); changing it restarts workers
fields.devices: Device ordinals or count the model runs on
fields.startup_concurrency: Workers loaded in parallel at startup; >1 speeds up multi-worker load at the cost of memory
fields.max_queue_size: Max requests waiting in the dispatch queue; excess is rejected
fields.queue_timeout_secs: Max seconds a request may wait in queue before the timeout action applies; 0 disables
fields.queue_timeout_action: What to do when the queue timeout elapses (delay / reject)
fields.request_timeout: Per-request hard timeout in seconds; 0 disables
fields.max_concurrent_streams: Max concurrent streaming requests per version; 0 = unlimited
fields.hot_reload: Watch model files and reload workers on change
fields.hot_reload_patterns: Glob patterns of files that trigger a hot reload
fields.max_requests: Auto-recycle a worker after this many requests; 0 disables
fields.max_requests_jitter: Random jitter added to max_requests to avoid synchronized recycles
fields.recycle_max_percent: Max % of workers allowed to roll-recycle at once
fields.count_streams_toward_max_requests: Count streaming requests toward the max_requests budget
fields.recycle_stream_drain_timeout_secs: Seconds to wait for in-flight streams during recycle before force-evicting
fields.recycle_stream_grace_ms: Grace window (ms) asking streams to close themselves before eviction
fields.stream: Enable streaming mode for this model
fields.max_retries: Retries of a failed batch on a different worker; 0 = no retry
fields.ejection_error_threshold: Consecutive errors before a worker is ejected; 0 = never
fields.ejection_timeout: Seconds an ejected worker stays out before auto-recovery
fields.ejection_max_percent: Max % of workers that may be ejected simultaneously
fields.ejection_max_timeout: Cap (seconds) for the exponential ejection backoff
fields.startup_timeout: Max seconds to wait for a worker's ready handshake
fields.health_check_interval: Seconds between active worker health probes; 0 disables
fields.health_check_timeout: Seconds before a single health probe times out
fields.health_check_kill_threshold: Consecutive failed probes before killing the worker; 0 = eject only
fields.worker_kill_timeout: Seconds a worker may take to stop gracefully before SIGKILL
fields.hooks: Worker lifecycle hooks (shell commands / HTTP callbacks); misconfiguration can break loading
fields.policies: Per-model policies: rate limit / CORS / auth / request log
